impactMatrix.headline: Gov. Nwifuru Transmits Executive Bill Seeking Capital Punishment for Kidnapping at Funeral of Murdered Monarch

globalCodeData_B1.intent: Deterring violent crimes, protecting traditional rulers, and hardening state security laws.
